create_InputPipeline: create an InputPipeline instance to pre-process image batches for pix2struct model inference
run_get_inference_fn: run get_inference_fn to build a JIT-compiled beam-search prediction function from a t5x checkpoint
test_InputPipeline_feed: test the InputPipeline feed method by feeding image byte batches and retrieving model input tensors
review_InputPipeline_input_shapes: review the InputPipeline input_shapes method to get batched tensor shape metadata for model inputs
summarize_InputPipeline_output_vocab: summarize the InputPipeline output_vocab method to retrieve the SentencePiece vocabulary for decoding predictions
